# PREDIGT score

```{r}
FG  <- TRUE # including factor G?
FT  <- TRUE # including factor T?

# PPV and NPV
prevalence <- 1/100 # prevalence
plotPPV <- TRUE

# compare AUC in Female vs Male
sex_ind <- 0 # 0: Both; 1: Female; 2: Male
```


```{r}
scrCalc <- function(data, varStr2, coefV, vFH, newVar, print = FALSE,
                    varStr_motor = NULL, coefV_motor = c(0.25, 1, 1)) {
  
  if (print) {
    for (i in 1:length(varStr2)) {
      print(table(data %>% select(all_of(varStr2[i])), useNA = "ifany"))
    }
  }
  # w/o motor
  varStr1 <- c(c("ID", "group", "sex","age"), varStr2)
  
  ind_question <- NULL # Only in self-report
  ind_D <- which(varStr2 == vFH)
  ind_E <- c(1:(ind_D-1))
  ind_I <- c((ind_D+1):length(varStr2))
  
  data$new <- PREDIGTScr(data, varStr1, varStr2, coefV, ind_question, unique(data$EVENT_ID), FG, FT, ind_E, 
                         ind_D, ind_I, method = 1)$data$score
  names(data)[which(names(data) == "new")] <- newVar
  
  # with motor
  if (!is.null(varStr_motor)){
    if (print) {
      for (i in 1:length(varStr_motor)) {
        print(table(data %>% select(all_of(varStr_motor[i])), useNA = "ifany"))
      }
    }
    varStr2 <- c(varStr2, varStr_motor)
    coefV <- c(coefV, coefV_motor)
    
    varStr1 <- c(c("ID", "group", "sex","age"), varStr2)
    
    ind_question <- NULL # Only in self-report
    ind_D <- which(varStr2 == vFH)
    ind_E <- c(1:(ind_D-1))
    ind_I <- c((ind_D+1):length(varStr2))
    
    data$new <- PREDIGTScr(data, varStr1, varStr2, coefV, ind_question, unique(data$EVENT_ID), FG, FT, ind_E, 
                           ind_D, ind_I, method = 1)$data$score
    names(data)[which(names(data) == "new")] <- paste0(newVar, "_motor")
  }
  
  return(data)
}
```

## Original

```{r}
# varStr2 <- c("Metal.PREDIGT", "Pesticide.PREDIGT", "Farm.PREDIGT", "Head.PREDIGT.M", 
#              "Constipation.PREDIGT.M", "Smell.PREDIGT", "Smoking.PREDIGT.M", "Caffeine.PREDIGT.M", 
#              "FH.PREDIGT.M",
#              "Depression.PREDIGT.M", "Anxiety.PREDIGT.M", "RBD.PREDIGT")
varStr2 <- varList$Short.name[which(varList$Original == 1)]

# Coeffcients
coefV <- c(0.5,     # 1:  Metal
           0.25,    # 2:  Pesiticide
           0.25,    # 3:  Farm
           0.5,     # 4:  head trauma
           0.5,     # 5:  constipation
           0.5,     # 6:  olfaction
           -0.0625, # 7:  smoking: any<10y*1, Ex11-19*2, Ex20*4, Current11-19*8, Current20*12
           -0.125,  # 8:  caffeine: >=1*1, >=2*2
           0.125,   # 9:  family history: 3rd*1, 2nd*2, 1st*4
           0.25,    # 10: depression
           0.25,    # 11: anxiety
           0.25     # 12: RBD
)

data <- scrCalc(data, varStr2, coefV, vFH = "family_history_dir", newVar = "PREDIGT_O", TRUE,
                NULL)

# score range
df_range <- data[1:2,] %>% select(-PREDIGT_O)
# min: 40 yrs female who responded negative to all the risk factors
df_range[1, which(names(data) %in% varStr2)] <- c(0,     # 1:  Metal
                                                  0,    # 2:  Pesiticide
                                                  0,    # 3:  Farm
                                                  0,     # 4:  head trauma
                                                  0,     # 5:  constipation
                                                  0,     # 6:  olfaction
                                                  12, # 7:  smoking: any<10y*1, Ex11-19*2, Ex20*4, Current11-19*8, Current20*12
                                                  2,  # 8:  caffeine: >=1*1, >=2*2
                                                  0,   # 9:  family history: 3rd*1, 2nd*2, 1st*4
                                                  0,    # 10: depression
                                                  0,    # 11: anxiety
                                                  0)     # 12: RBD
df_range[1, "sex"] <- "Female"
df_range[1, "age"] <- 40
# min: 100 yrs male who responded positive to all the risk factors
df_range[2, which(names(df_range) %in% varStr2)] <- c(1,     # 1:  Metal
                                                  1,    # 2:  Pesiticide
                                                  1,    # 3:  Farm
                                                  2,     # 4:  head trauma
                                                  1,     # 5:  constipation
                                                  1,     # 6:  olfaction
                                                  0, # 7:  smoking: any<10y*1, Ex11-19*2, Ex20*4, Current11-19*8, Current20*12
                                                  0,  # 8:  caffeine: >=1*1, >=2*2
                                                  4,   # 9:  family history: 3rd*1, 2nd*2, 1st*4
                                                  1,    # 10: depression
                                                  1,    # 11: anxiety
                                                  1)     # 12: RBD
df_range[2, "sex"] <- "Male"
df_range[2, "age"] <- 100
df_range <- scrCalc(df_range, varStr2, coefV, vFH = "family_history_dir", newVar = "PREDIGT_O", FALSE,
                NULL)
df_range$PREDIGT_O
```

## Simplified, multi-level

```{r}
# varStr2 <- c("Constipation.PREDIGT.M", "Smell.PREDIGT", 
#              "FH.PREDIGT.M",
#              "Depression.PREDIGT.M", "Anxiety.PREDIGT.M", "RBD.PREDIGT")
varStr2 <- varList$Short.name[which(varList$Simple_m == 1)]

# Coeffcients
coefV <- c(0.25,    # 1:  constipation: Never, 0; Sometimes, 0.25; Regularly/Often: 0.5
           0.5,     # 2:  olfaction
           0.125,   # 3:  family history: 3rd*1, 2nd*2, 1st*4
           0.125,   # 4: depression: Normal, 0; Slight/Mild, 0.125; Moderate/Severe, 0.25
           0.125,   # 5: anxiety: Normal, 0; Slight/Mild, 0.125; Moderate/Severe, 0.25
           0.25     # 6: RBD
)  

# add motor
#varStr_motor <- c("Fatigue.PREDIGT.M", "Handwriting.PREDIGT.M", "Slowness.PREDIGT.M")
varStr_motor <- varList$Short.name[which(varList$Motor_m == 1)]
coefV_motor <- c(0.125,    # 7: fatigue: Normal, 0; Slight/Mild, 0.125; Moderate/Severe, 0.25
                 0.5,      # 8: handwriting: Normal, 0; Slight/Mild, 0.5; Moderate/Severe, 1
                 0.5       # 9: slowness: Normal, 0; Slight/Mild, 0.5; Moderate/Severe, 1
)  

data <- scrCalc(data, varStr2, coefV, vFH = "family_history_dir", newVar = "PREDIGT_S_M", TRUE,
                varStr_motor, coefV_motor)
```

# 2-step combined

```{r}
df_dev <- data %>% filter(group %in% c("HC", "PD/DLB")) %>% droplevels() %>% 
  mutate(group_num = ifelse(group == "HC", 0, 1))

df_res <- data.frame()

# PREDIGT_O + UPSIT_scr
fit1 <- glm(group_num ~ PREDIGT_O + UPSIT_scr, data = df_dev, family = binomial())
summary(fit1)
data$PREDIGT_O_UPSIT <- predict(fit1, newdata = data, type="response") * 100 # using probability
df_res <- bind_rows(df_res,
                    data.frame(name = "PREDIGT_O + UPSIT_scr",
                               intercept = coef(fit1)[1],
                               questionnaire = coef(fit1)[2],
                               smell_test = coef(fit1)[3]))

# PREDIGT_S_B + UPSIT_scr
```
